blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Routine is the best English teacher. At the trading desk, every day has a rhythm. James starts work, checks his emails, calls clients, works with the team, and finishes at 6 pm.

Today we use the Present Simple to talk about this rhythm. We say "I start work at 9" and "I check emails every morning". These small sentences are simple, but they help a lot.

Take your time. Every sentence counts. Five useful words and plenty of practice — that is the plan for today.

items.q: What time does James finish work?
items.why: "...and finishes at 6 pm." Ele termina às 6 da tarde.

items.q: What does James do in the morning?
items.why: "I check emails every morning." De manhã ele checa os e-mails.

items.q: Which grammar does the lesson use today?
items.why: "Today we use the Present Simple to talk about this rhythm."

items.q: The text says "every day has a rhythm". This suggests that…
options: the days follow a similar pattern
items.why: Inferência: "rhythm" (ritmo) mostra que os dias seguem um padrão parecido.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: small, simple sentences can help a lot
long sentences are the best way to learn
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que as frases são simples "but they help a lot" e que a rotina é a melhor professora.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James falar sobre o seu dia na mesa de operações. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello. My name is James, and I work at Czarnikow, at the trading desk. Let me tell you about my day. It is simple, but I like it.

I start work at nine in the morning. First, I check my emails. I read them slowly, with a coffee. There are always many emails, but I stay calm. Then I call two or three clients. I like to talk to them early, before the market is busy.

We work in a big team. My team is friendly, and we help each other every day. When I have a question, I ask a colleague. We have a short meeting on Monday. We talk about the week and the plan. I like these meetings because they are quick and clear.

In the afternoon, I write reports. I write my reports on Friday. The office is quiet, and I can think. I drink coffee at ten, and again after lunch. Coffee is important for me!

I finish work at six. Then I go home and I rest. Tomorrow, I start again at nine. My day is the same every day, and that is good. The routine helps me at work, and it helps my English too.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where does James work?
items.why: "I work at Czarnikow, at the trading desk."

items.q: What does James do first in the morning?
items.why: "First, I check my emails." Primeiro ele checa os e-mails.

items.q: When does James write his reports?
items.why: "I write my reports on Friday."

items.q: James says the meeting is short and the team helps each other. This suggests that…
options: he enjoys working with his team
he does not like his team
items.why: Inferência: "My team is friendly, and we help each other" mostra que ele gosta do time.

items.q: Why does James say the routine helps him?
options: Because he wants to change jobs
Because he does not like coffee
Because it helps his work and his English
items.why: Inferência: "The routine helps me, and it helps my English too."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I start work at nine." To start means to…
items.why: Start = começar. Ele começa o trabalho às nove.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We ___ in a big team every day."
items.why: Work = trabalhar. "We work in a big team."

items.q: "You finish at six." To finish means to…
items.why: Finish = terminar. Você termina às seis.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I ___ my emails every morning."
items.why: Check = checar. "I check emails every morning."

items.q: "I call clients every day." To call means to…
items.why: Call = ligar. Ele liga (telefona) para os clientes todo dia.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples do dia a dia no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "I start work at nine." To start work means to…
options: begin your job for the day
items.why: Start work = começar a trabalhar (o dia).

items.q: "Please call me back later." To call someone back means to…
items.why: Call back = ligar de volta, telefonar novamente.

items.q: "I check in with my team on Monday." To check in means to…
options: talk quickly to see how things are
items.why: Check in = dar um alô rápido, ver como estão as coisas.

items.q: "Let's wrap up the meeting now." To wrap up means to…
items.why: Wrap up = terminar, encerrar.

items.q: "I log off at six and go home." To log off means to…
items.why: Log off = desconectar, sair do sistema/computador.
